html:
Jerk is the Jamaican way of seasoning meat with allspice, Scotch bonnet peppers and herbs, and cooking it slowly over pimento wood. It is linked above all with the Maroons of the Blue Mountains.

The Maroons, hiding from the British, hunted wild pigs and cooked them in covered pits that gave off little smoke. They built on the methods of the Taino, who smoked meat on wooden frames, the origin of the word barbecue.

Jerk pork and chicken are now sold from oil drum grills across Jamaica and in Jamaican communities abroad. Boston in Portland parish is known as the home of jerk.
